name: St. Regis Venice
insider_take: The St. Regis Venice occupies a stunning 19th-century palazzo on the Grand Canal, where Venetian aristocracy once entertained royalty and famous guests still arrive by private water taxi.
whats_special: This palatial hotel features the city's only rooftop terrace overlooking the Grand Canal, plus Venice's deepest indoor swimming pool. The property's historic ballroom hosted legendary masquerade balls, and its butler service includes arranging private gondola serenades and exclusive after-hours access to St. Mark's Basilica.
pro_tip: Book a canal-view suite during acqua alta (high tide) season for the magical experience of watching Venice transform as water laps at the hotel's waterfront terrace.
dont_miss: Sunset aperitivos on the rooftop terrace with 360-degree views of Venice's skyline, and dinner at Gio's Restaurant where the chef sources ingredients from the historic Rialto fish market each morning via the hotel's private boat.
pros: Prime location on the Grand Canal with stunning water views
Exceptional butler service and personalized attention
Elegant rooms and suites with luxury Venetian design
World-class dining experiences and rooftop terrace
cons: Premium pricing reflective of luxury positioning
Limited parking availability due to Venice location
